title: The Information in Hedge Fund Option Holdings
eligible_reason: No binary staggered treatment. All regressions in 'stata command.do' are stock-quarter panel regressions of future DGTW-adjusted returns (futureqtrreta) or earnings surprises (sue3) on the continuous net-options variable diffinsthf2 (and its positive/negative parts), short interest, controls and year-quarter dummies (i.yq), two-way clustered by permno and yq via cluster2. No unit fixed effects, no adoption event; interactions with period/VIX/TED market-stress indicators are not staggered treatments. The ft_callaway flag is a false positive.
design_notes: Hedge fund 13F option positions 2004Q4-2015Q3 merged with CRSP/Compustat/Markit/OPRA; SAS data construction (AHP1-3.sas), Stata regressions (Tables 2-4, 6-8).

specs.exclusion_reason: continuous regressor; no unit FE; not a DiD
specs.treatment_definition: net (call minus put) HF option holdings
specs.controls: none (col 1); avgreluspread logdolvol logme realizedvol pastqtrreta iot_hf (col 2)

data_files: sampledata.xlsx (316 KB; 30% stratified random sample of the Net Options variable only)
software_notes: SAS for data construction (AHP1.sas, AHP2.sas; AHP3.sas referenced in ReadMe but not present), Stata for regressions (cluster2).
screener_notes: Screened from package only (ReadMe.txt, variable definition.txt, stata command.do read in full). Regression list empty because the pipeline did not parse 'stata command.do'.
